name: claude-essentials
description: A public marketplace of Claude Code plugins, skills, and agents — install via /plugin marketplace add nerymurillohnd/claude-essentials.

plugins.name: block-no-verify
plugins.description: A skill that, only when you ask and approve a scope, installs a Claude Code hook denying Git commands that skip local hooks or commit signing (--no-verify, -n, --no-gpg-sign, core.hooksPath, HUSKY=0, ...). Installing the plugin wires nothing.

plugins.name: verify-completion
plugins.description: Makes Claude prove work is done before saying so: a six-gate verification skill with coherence and depth audits, a read-only verifier agent scaled to the size of the change, an opt-in workflow that cross-checks every finding, and a Stop hook that sends Claude back for a checkable Verification record when a reply presents finished work without one. It never authorizes commits, pushes, or deploys.
